jobs.title: Director, EAML Strategy & Reporting
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As Director, Strategy & Reporting for the Enterprise Anti-Money Laundering (EAML) team, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and advancing the division's strategic priorities. Reporting to the VP, Strategy, Governance & Advisory, you'll collaborate with senior leaders to define the purpose, vision, and core strategy for EAML, while implementing frameworks to track progress against divisional goals. You'll oversee the development and production of senior executive and board reporting for the AML/Anti-Terrorist Financing (ATF) Program, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery. Your strategic insights will help optimize operational capacity and workforce planning, and you'll lead a team dedicated to maintaining high standards in reporting and governance. Building strong relationships across CIBC, you'll be a key connector between EAML and partner departments, supporting compliance and driving continuous improvement.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed

Strategic Planning & Execution – Collaborate with senior leadership to define EAML priorities, develop strategic roadmaps, and monitor progress against objectives, providing updates and identifying areas for improvement.
Reporting & Metrics Management – Lead the team responsible for producing monthly, quarterly, and annual reports for Boards, Committees, and senior executives; ensure data accuracy, consistency, and visually clear presentation.
Capacity Planning & Forecasting – Analyze operational workflows and resource allocation, present insights to inform workforce planning, and continuously refine forecasting models to align with evolving business needs.
Governance & Compliance – Build and maintain governance frameworks for EAML metrics, manage access to reports, and ensure compliance with CIBC policies and controls.
Team Leadership & Development – Provide effective management and mentorship to staff, set context for assignments, build team capabilities through development opportunities, and foster a positive, inclusive work environment.
Cross-Functional Collaboration – Establish and nurture strong relationships with key internal partners across Risk Management, Finance, Internal Audit, Human Resources, Chief Administration Office, and Corporate Secretary.

Who You Are

You have expertise in AML, Compliance, or Risk Management. Your experience enables you to navigate complex regulatory environments and contribute to strategic planning.
You're a strategic thinker. You bring a university degree and a strong understanding of value creation, options analysis, and business performance metrics.
You're an analytical problem solver. Your excellent analytical skills support data interpretation, risk management, and informed decision-making.
You're a skilled communicator. You have exceptional written and presentation skills, and can clearly document and convey complex concepts to diverse audiences, including senior executives and board members.
You're an effective team leader. You have proven experience managing high-performing teams, providing mentorship, and aligning individual roles with business priorities.
You're highly organized and detail-oriented. You consistently deliver accurate and comprehensive reports, maintaining strong attention to detail.
You value collaboration and influence. You build strong relationships across departments and can influence outcomes to support divisional goals.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

What You Need To Know

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.
You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.
We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).
We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Operations (Job Costing & Revenue)
jobs.description:
Contract Opportunity

Location:
Stouffville, ON (Primarily On-Site)

Our client, a growing operations-driven organization, is seeking an experienced finance leader to oversee job costing, project profitability, revenue performance, and operational financial controls. This is a hands-on leadership role reporting directly to senior leadership and working closely with finance, sales, operations, and billing teams to drive accountability, margins, and business performance.

This opportunity is ideal for a senior finance professional who thrives in a dynamic environment where operational execution, costing accuracy, revenue oversight, and financial discipline are critical to success.

This role will require understanding of project-based finance/accounting from transportation, logistics or construction industry with background in job costing, project costing, operational finance, or profitability analysis.

Key Responsibilities

Job Costing & Profitability Management

Develop, maintain, and enhance job costing and project costing methodologies.
Monitor actual costs against estimates and investigate variances by project, customer, and service line.
Ensure labour, equipment, subcontractor, and material costs are accurately captured and allocated.
Drive accountability around project scope, cost control, and margin performance.
Support pricing, quoting, and bidding decisions through profitability analysis and financial insights.
Oversee change management processes related to project scope and pricing adjustments.

Revenue & Sales Performance Oversight

Partner with sales leadership to monitor revenue performance, pipeline activity, forecasts, and profitability.
Review pricing strategies to balance competitiveness and margin protection.
Ensure accurate and timely revenue recognition.
Prepare revenue forecasts and performance reporting for leadership.
Support ongoing revenue growth initiatives through analytics and decision support.

Billing, Accounts Receivable & Financial Controls

Oversee invoicing processes to ensure timely and accurate billing.
Monitor accounts receivable aging and support collection efforts.
Resolve billing discrepancies and customer-related financial issues.
Strengthen billing procedures and internal controls.

Accounting & Reporting

Review bank reconciliations, general ledger activity, accruals, and month-end entries.
Support month-end and year-end close processes.
Prepare financial reporting packages focused on profitability, revenue performance, cash flow, and operational metrics.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, reporting, and financial efficiency.

Leadership

Lead and mentor cross-functional team members across finance, billing, sales support, and operations.
Act as a strategic business partner to operational and executive leadership.
Drive collaboration between finance and operations to improve decision-making and profitability.

Qualifications

CPA designation preferred.
7+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including leadership responsibilities.
Strong background in job costing, project costing, operational finance, or profitability analysis.
Experience within transportation, logistics, construction, industrial services, manufacturing, or other project-based environments is highly desirable.
Demonstrated success partnering with operations and commercial teams to drive accountability and financial performance.
Hands-on experience with month-end close, general ledger, reconciliations, billing, and financial reporting.
Experience overseeing accounts receivable and revenue management processes.
Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with accounting systems such as Sage, QuickBooks, or comparable ERP platforms.
Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

High-impact finance leadership role with direct visibility to executive leadership.
Opportunity to influence costing methodology, operational performance, and profitability.
Broad scope spanning finance, operations, revenue management, and reporting.
Flexible contract engagement with the potential to evolve into a part-time long-term arrangement.
Primarily on-site role based in Stouffville, Ontario.

jobs.title: Director, AI Operations
jobs.description:
What We’re Looking For:

As the Director, AI Operations, you will be the operational force behind the scaling and integration of Artificial Intelligence across Omnicom’s Canadian portfolio Reporting directly to the Head of AI, Omnicom Advertising Canada, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge technical innovation and real-world agency execution.

What You’ll Do:

Operational Scaling
: Working the VP, Agency Operations, implement standardized frameworks for AI deployment across departments to ensure consistency, efficiency, and compliance.
Workflow Integration
: Audit existing agency workflows to identify AI-ready touchpoints, deploying use cases that reduce manual overhead and elevate human creativity.
Infrastructure Management
: Oversee the operational health of AI platforms, ensuring seamless access to the Omnicom AI ecosystem and approved third-party tools.
Performance Tracking
: Define and track key metrics (i.e. ROI, time-savings, output volume) to quantify the impact of AI initiatives on agency growth.
Innovation Pipeline
: Proactively scout for emerging AI tools and lead rapid Proof of Concept experiments to test agency applications before scaling.
Onboarding & Approvals
: Navigate end-to-end the internal vetting process for new AI tools.
AI workflows
: Shape the workflows and internal experience with
Node-based tools (n8n, Figma Weave, Magnific).

What You Bring:

7+ years of experience in operations, project management, program management, account leadership, innovation, digital transformation, or a related field.
Experience working in an advertising, marketing, creative, media, technology, or agency environment strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects from strategy through implementation.
Experience managing multiple workstreams, timelines, priorities, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of AI technologies, platforms, tools, and emerging capabilities, with a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the creative and marketing landscape.
Practical experience using or implementing generative AI tools and platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Adobe Firefly, or similar tools.
Experience identifying opportunities to improve workflows, automate processes, increase efficiency, and enhance team capabilities through technology.
Experience working with senior leadership and influencing stakeholders across multiple disciplines.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex technology concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Experience developing processes, frameworks, playbooks, guidelines, or operating models that help teams adopt new tools and ways of working.
Comfortable working in an environment where technology, platforms, and best practices are constantly evolving.

Who We Are:

TBWA is The Disruption® Company, a global agency collective of 10,000+ creative minds operating in over 80 countries. Named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company four years in a row, we are a disruptive brand experience company that uses creativity to help businesses acquire a greater share of the future.
We believe in doing the brave thing.

Doing the brave thing
is about courage. It’s about never being a spectator. Speaking up with clarity and conviction and kindness. Not hedging our points-of-view with clients or each other. Saying what we think when it’s in the best interest of the idea or the people, even if it’s uncomfortable. Being willing to take smart risks. Making tough decisions without agonizing. And, being transparent and vulnerable in search of the best. This is the expectation for all of us. In turn, we commit to perpetuating a culture where bravery is rewarded and support is always within reach. TBWA\Canada develops strategies, advertising and brand experiences for some of the world's most iconic brands, with offices in Toronto, Edmonton and Montreal.

The Company:

At TBWA\Canada, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB) are our core values. We are committed to a diverse workforce and aim to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace where employees feel valued, respected, and supported. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and lived experiences. If you require an accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact our Human Resources team and we would be happy to work with you to meet your needs.

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $120,000 per year. Compensation will be determined based on qualifications, relevant experience, and internal equity. This posting represents an active vacancy that we are currently hiring for.

AI Use:

TBWA\Canada uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as enhancing job postings and analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but will never replace the human judgement that guides our hiring decisions. We will only contact shortlisted candidates for this role.

Notice: Online Hiring Scams

Please be aware that individuals not associated with TBWA\Canada and/or Omnicom Advertising Group have fraudulently used our name and branding to solicit applications for fake jobs, to conduct fake job interviews, and/or to make fake job offers.
TBWA\Canada / Omnicom Advertising Group will never contact you from a personal email account (@gmail.com, @hotmail.com, etc.) nor ask for money in exchange for recruitment services such as background screenings, equipment costs, etc. No financial information will be requested for recruitment purposes (bank account, credit card details, etc.). Interviewers will not ask for confidential or personal information (driver’s license or passport, a social insurance number or a social security number, credit card, or banking information). Interviews are conducted in person or via web conferencing (Zoom or Microsoft Teams only), not through text or messaging apps (WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, FaceTime, SMS, etc.).

If you have provided personal information in connection with a fake job offer or interview and you are concerned, we suggest you take appropriate action and contact local law enforcement in your area, and contact our local Human Resources team.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Area Vice President, AI Data Platform – Canada Enterprise

Come and Join Us!

Oracle is seeking a strategic, customer-focused Area Vice President, AI Data Platform – Canada Enterprise to lead our AI Data Platform business across Canada.

This executive leadership role will have responsibility for Oracle's AI Data Platform business across all Commercial and Enterprise customer segments and industry verticals throughout Canada, helping organizations modernize their technology environments, accelerate AI adoption, unlock the value of their data, and transform mission-critical workloads.

Leading a national organization of Sales and partnering with Sales Engineering professionals, you will develop and execute the go-to-market strategy for Oracle's AI Data Platform portfolio across Canada. You will be responsible for building a high-performance culture, developing exceptional talent, driving predictable growth, and strengthening Oracle's position as a strategic technology partner to Canada's leading organizations.

Working closely across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Applications, Consulting, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Alliances, you will bring together the full power of Oracle to help Canadian customers accelerate transformation through AI, data, cloud, and multicloud innovation.

What You'll Do

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing national organization of Sales and Sales Engineering leaders and professionals responsible for Oracle's AI Data Platform business across Canada.
Own and execute the Canada Enterprise go-to-market strategy across Commercial and Enterprise customers spanning all major industry verticals, including Telecommunications, Media, Technology, Retail, Manufacturing, Transportation, Energy, Professional Services, and other strategic industries.
Drive consistent execution against bookings, cloud consumption, pipeline, revenue, market growth, and customer success objectives while establishing a culture of accountability and predictable performance.
Help Canada's leading organizations modernize legacy technology environments, consolidate and simplify data platforms, migrate mission-critical workloads, and accelerate the adoption of AI and next-generation data architectures.
Champion Oracle's multicloud strategy, helping customers take advantage of Oracle technology across OCI and Oracle's strategic partnerships with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud.
Build trusted relationships with CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business executives, and other senior decision-makers, positioning Oracle as a strategic partner for their most important technology and business transformation initiatives.
Lead strategic account planning, executive engagement, pipeline development, forecasting, territory strategy, and business reviews to create disciplined execution and sustainable growth across the Canadian market.
Partner closely with OCI, Applications, Consulting, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Alliances, and other Oracle organizations to deliver a unified strategy for customers and maximize opportunities across Oracle's portfolio.
Develop and expand strategic relationships with Global Systems Integrators (GSIs), Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), cloud providers, and technology ecosystem partners to increase market reach and accelerate customer adoption.
Build a strong partnership between Sales and Sales Engineering, ensuring technical strategy, customer value, executive engagement, and commercial execution are tightly aligned throughout the customer lifecycle.
Recruit, develop, retain, and inspire exceptional talent while creating a culture centered on customer success, collaboration, innovation, accountability, and high performance.
Represent Oracle at executive customer engagements, industry forums, conferences, partner events, and strategic engagements while serving as executive sponsor for some of Oracle's most important Canadian customers.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of enterprise technology experience, with significant experience leading high-performing enterprise sales, go-to-market, or customer-facing organizations.
Proven success leading large, geographically distributed teams, ideally including both Sales and Sales Engineering or closely integrated commercial and technical organizations.
Demonstrated success growing businesses across multiple industries, customer segments, and technology portfolios.
Deep experience with AI, data platforms, databases, cloud infrastructure, analytics, enterprise software, or related technologies.
A strong track record of exceeding revenue objectives, building pipeline, managing complex enterprise sales cycles, and delivering predictable business performance.
Experience engaging and influencing C-suite executives and senior technology and business leaders within large Canadian organizations.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute a country-level go-to-market strategy, translating corporate priorities into clear market, industry, account, and execution plans.
Strong executive presence with exceptional leadership, talent development, communication, forecasting, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Ability to operate effectively across a complex global organization and bring together multiple teams around a common customer and market strategy.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Significant leadership experience within the Canadian Enterprise technology market, with an understanding of the country's major industries, customers, partners, and technology ecosystem.
Deep knowledge of AI, data platforms, analytics, databases, cloud infrastructure, and multicloud architectures.
Experience leading enterprise AI transformation, cloud modernization, data modernization, and mission-critical workload transformation initiatives.
Experience building and leading integrated Sales and Sales Engineering organizations.
Established executive relationships across Canada's Enterprise and Commercial customer landscape.
Experience developing strategic partnerships with GSIs, cloud providers, ISVs, and other technology ecosystem partners.

Why Oracle?

Oracle is helping Canada's leading organizations transform how they operate, compete, innovate, and serve their customers through AI, cloud, and data innovation.

As Area Vice President, AI Data Platform – Canada Enterprise, you will have the opportunity to lead Oracle's national AI Data Platform organization across Commercial and Enterprise customers, bringing together Sales and Sales Engineering under a unified Canadian strategy.

You will shape how Oracle engages Canada's most important organizations, develop the next generation of sales and technical leaders, and help customers modernize their most critical technology environments.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a high-performance national organization, accelerate the growth of Oracle's AI Data Platform business, and establish Canada as a model for how Oracle brings together AI, data, cloud, and multicloud innovation to deliver transformational outcomes for customers.

Responsibilities

Manages and develops a team of sales representatives including recruiting, hiring, and training new reps on the Oracle sales process. May manage a Regional Manager or Branch Manager. Sells and promotes the sales of Oracle products to customers including negotiating price, other concessions and terms and conditions of the sale. Participates in strategic and tactical planning for the division. Builds working relationships with license, consulting and education field managers in the respective territory to develop joint account plans. Develops and execute a territory plan to maximize revenue. Generates and achieves monthly territory forecasts, and accurately predicts revenue on a monthly basis. Manages escalation. jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Data Transformation
jobs.description:
About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

As a product-focused lead within the Data Transformation Office, you will partner with the Transformation Office leadership team to bring structure, governance, and product thinking to our API platform initiative. Drawing on your project governance background and hands-on analytics exposure, you will translate high-level business needs into a clear product roadmap, user stories, and delivery milestones. You will help shape how our APIs are designed, consumed, and evolved — turning a technical asset into a well-managed product that internal teams and clients can depend on.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Contribute to the API product vision and align the roadmap to strategic goals
Establish and maintain governance structures (intake, prioritization, change control, versioning) for the API portfolio
Create and maintain extensive documentation — including API catalogs, consumer guides, and decision logs — to enable self-service knowledge dissemination
Identify opportunities to improve processes and generate new product ideas informed by analytics and usage patterns
Work with the Product Owner and stakeholders to prioritize enhancements and manage the backlog
Anticipate, identify, manage and mitigate risks and cross-project dependencies
Manage expectations of senior management and stakeholders, facilitate steering committees, and provide regular status reports
Help to break down organizational silos and promote collaboration between business, engineering, and operations
Ensure quality of work being delivered by being involved in testing efforts, including API contract and UAT validation
Through partnership with the business, define, sponsor and steer API product initiatives
Influence and guide technology, project management, and operations teams in solution delivery
Translate light-touch data analysis (SQL, basic scripting) into product hypotheses and feature ideas
Maintain and develop expertise and keep abreast of market trends, API standards, and competitor offerings
Collaborate with other product teams on prioritization, reuse of endpoints, and shared components
Define success metrics (adoption, latency, error rates, consumer satisfaction) and use them to steer the roadmap
Work with Platform and Application teams to design API solutions in alignment with our business objectives

Qualifications

About You

5+ years hands-on experience in project/program governance, product ownership, and documentation
Working knowledge of SQL and/or basic scripting/analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Power Query, or Python fundamentals)
Experience with Power BI, Qlik, or similar reporting/visualization tools is an advantage
Collaborates effectively with individuals of varying technical ability and business acumen
Learns quickly and thrives in a fast moving, dynamic atmosphere
Strong project governance skills — intake processes, prioritization frameworks, risk/change control — with attention to detail and proven ability to multi-task
Strong knowledge of Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence)
PMP, Certified Scrum Master, or Certified Scrum Product Owner a plus
Skills in negotiation, influencing, stakeholder management
Track record of organizing and structuring technical initiatives (e.g., API programs) from a product/governance perspective
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong visual communication skills (PowerPoint, Visio, Smart Sheets)

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy and Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Req Id:
432851

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell AI Fabric is building Canada's largest sovereign AI infrastructure platform. As Director, Strategic Finance & Corporate Development, you will work at the centre of Bell AI Fabric's most important investment, capital allocation, commercial, and growth decisions, providing the financial insight and execution discipline required to scale the business.

This is a highly visible, hands-on finance role with unusual breadth and access. Working directly with senior executives, the Bell AI Fabric Board, Bell Finance leadership, and business teams, you will lead business cases, financial modelling, capital planning, performance analysis, and finance support for major customer, partnership, and infrastructure opportunities.

You will turn complex operational, commercial, tax, and accounting inputs into clear financial conclusions and decision-ready materials. You will also manage and develop team members, set priorities, review work closely, and raise the quality, precision, and pace of the team's output.

This is a unique opportunity for a finance, consulting, investment banking, or corporate development professional who wants to help build something consequential and expand their responsibilities quickly. You do not need to arrive knowing every aspect of the business. Success will come from curiosity, sound judgment, humility, exceptional care in the work, and a willingness to invest the effort required to learn and figure things out.

Key Responsibilities

Act as a trusted strategic finance partner to the executive team, leading the financial analysis behind Bell AI Fabric's highest-priority investments, commercial opportunities, and growth initiatives.
Build, maintain, and drive integrated financial models, business cases, forecasts, sensitivities, and decision tools that connect customer demand, pricing, capacity, capital requirements, operating costs, tax, accounting, and expected returns.
Lead monthly and quarterly capital allocation processes, assess competing requirements, challenge assumptions, and recommend how capital should be prioritized across projects and opportunities.
Question business stakeholders constructively and use judgment to reconcile commercial ambition, financial discipline, operational realities, risk, and timing into the best overall financial decision.
Support major customer opportunities, partnerships, financing initiatives, and transactions through rigorous economics, scenario analysis, financial diligence, and executive recommendations, while partnering with the deal lead on negotiations and structuring.
Work closely with Tax, Accounting, Treasury, FP&A, Corporate Development, and project teams to ensure financial conclusions reflect the appropriate treatment, assumptions, controls, and enterprise requirements.
Translate financial priorities into executable workplans with clear outputs, owners, milestones, dependencies, review points, and escalation paths; drive workstreams through completion.
Identify and improve financial processes, governance, model controls, reporting, and decision-support capabilities as Bell AI Fabric scales.

Critical Qualifications

Typically 6-10 years of experience in strategic finance, corporate development, investment banking, management consulting, FP&A, project finance, accounting, or another environment that develops comparable financial and execution capabilities.
Strong financial modelling capability, including experience building integrated models, business cases, forecasts, sensitivities, and scenario analyses that support significant decisions.
Demonstrated ability to review complex models and analyses with precision, identify errors or unsupported assumptions, and improve the quality and clarity of the underlying work.
Strong PowerPoint, executive communication, and financial storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clean, decision-oriented materials for senior executives and the Bell AI Fabric Board.
Sound financial and commercial judgment, with the confidence to question stakeholders, pressure-test assumptions, and recommend a practical path forward.
Working knowledge of tax, accounting, and financial reporting considerations, and the ability to partner effectively with subject-matter experts.
Experience managing or developing others, setting clear expectations, reviewing work closely, and maintaining accountability without creating unnecessary hierarchy.
High capacity and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly across multiple urgent priorities without compromising accuracy or quality.
Ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, learn unfamiliar topics quickly, and invest additional effort during critical periods to reach a well-supported answer.

Preferred Qualifications

CPA, CFA, or equivalent financial designations or advanced finance training; candidates with strong equivalent experience are also encouraged to apply.
Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, investments, partnerships, due diligence, valuation, integration planning, or other transaction-related work.
Experience in infrastructure, technology, telecommunications, energy, data centres, project finance, or another capital-intensive industry.
Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with disciplined model structure, documentation, version control, and quality assurance.
Strong curiosity and a demonstrated ability to become credible quickly on unfamiliar commercial, technical, tax, and accounting topics.
A practical, collaborative, and low-ego working style, including comfort receiving challenge, changing course when the facts require it, and sharing credit with the team.
High standards for pace, precision, ownership, accountability, and follow-through, combined with a genuine interest in difficult problems and continuous learning.

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

Additional Information

Position Type:
Management

Job Status:
Regular - Full Time

Job Location:
Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Work Arrangement:
Hybrid

Application Deadline:
10/15/2026

For work arrangements that are ‘Hybrid’, successful candidates must be based in Canada and report to a set Bell office for a minimum of 3 days a week. Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, Bell offers flexibility in work hours based on the business needs.

Please apply directly online to be considered for this role. Applications through email will not be accepted.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Data Transformation
new_jobs.description:
About Citco

JOB DESCRIPTION

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

As a product-focused lead within the Data Transformation Office, you will partner with the Transformation Office leadership team to bring structure, governance, and product thinking to our API platform initiative. Drawing on your project governance background and hands-on analytics exposure, you will translate high-level business needs into a clear product roadmap, user stories, and delivery milestones. You will help shape how our APIs are designed, consumed, and evolved — turning a technical asset into a well-managed product that internal teams and clients can depend on.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Contribute to the API product vision and align the roadmap to strategic goals
Establish and maintain governance structures (intake, prioritization, change control, versioning) for the API portfolio
Create and maintain extensive documentation — including API catalogs, consumer guides, and decision logs — to enable self-service knowledge dissemination
Identify opportunities to improve processes and generate new product ideas informed by analytics and usage patterns
Work with the Product Owner and stakeholders to prioritize enhancements and manage the backlog
Anticipate, identify, manage and mitigate risks and cross-project dependencies
Manage expectations of senior management and stakeholders, facilitate steering committees, and provide regular status reports
Help to break down organizational silos and promote collaboration between business, engineering, and operations
Ensure quality of work being delivered by being involved in testing efforts, including API contract and UAT validation
Through partnership with the business, define, sponsor and steer API product initiatives
Influence and guide technology, project management, and operations teams in solution delivery
Translate light-touch data analysis (SQL, basic scripting) into product hypotheses and feature ideas
Maintain and develop expertise and keep abreast of market trends, API standards, and competitor offerings
Collaborate with other product teams on prioritization, reuse of endpoints, and shared components
Define success metrics (adoption, latency, error rates, consumer satisfaction) and use them to steer the roadmap
Work with Platform and Application teams to design API solutions in alignment with our business objectives

Qualifications

About You

5+ years hands-on experience in project/program governance, product ownership, and documentation
Working knowledge of SQL and/or basic scripting/analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Power Query, or Python fundamentals)
Experience with Power BI, Qlik, or similar reporting/visualization tools is an advantage
Collaborates effectively with individuals of varying technical ability and business acumen
Learns quickly and thrives in a fast moving, dynamic atmosphere
Strong project governance skills — intake processes, prioritization frameworks, risk/change control — with attention to detail and proven ability to multi-task
Strong knowledge of Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence)
PMP, Certified Scrum Master, or Certified Scrum Product Owner a plus
Skills in negotiation, influencing, stakeholder management
Track record of organizing and structuring technical initiatives (e.g., API programs) from a product/governance perspective
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong visual communication skills (PowerPoint, Visio, Smart Sheets)

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

new_jobs.title: Director, Strategy and Corporate Development
new_jobs.description:
Req Id:
432851

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell AI Fabric is building Canada's largest sovereign AI infrastructure platform. As Director, Strategic Finance & Corporate Development, you will work at the centre of Bell AI Fabric's most important investment, capital allocation, commercial, and growth decisions, providing the financial insight and execution discipline required to scale the business.

This is a highly visible, hands-on finance role with unusual breadth and access. Working directly with senior executives, the Bell AI Fabric Board, Bell Finance leadership, and business teams, you will lead business cases, financial modelling, capital planning, performance analysis, and finance support for major customer, partnership, and infrastructure opportunities.

You will turn complex operational, commercial, tax, and accounting inputs into clear financial conclusions and decision-ready materials. You will also manage and develop team members, set priorities, review work closely, and raise the quality, precision, and pace of the team's output.

This is a unique opportunity for a finance, consulting, investment banking, or corporate development professional who wants to help build something consequential and expand their responsibilities quickly. You do not need to arrive knowing every aspect of the business. Success will come from curiosity, sound judgment, humility, exceptional care in the work, and a willingness to invest the effort required to learn and figure things out.

Key Responsibilities

Act as a trusted strategic finance partner to the executive team, leading the financial analysis behind Bell AI Fabric's highest-priority investments, commercial opportunities, and growth initiatives.
Build, maintain, and drive integrated financial models, business cases, forecasts, sensitivities, and decision tools that connect customer demand, pricing, capacity, capital requirements, operating costs, tax, accounting, and expected returns.
Lead monthly and quarterly capital allocation processes, assess competing requirements, challenge assumptions, and recommend how capital should be prioritized across projects and opportunities.
Question business stakeholders constructively and use judgment to reconcile commercial ambition, financial discipline, operational realities, risk, and timing into the best overall financial decision.
Support major customer opportunities, partnerships, financing initiatives, and transactions through rigorous economics, scenario analysis, financial diligence, and executive recommendations, while partnering with the deal lead on negotiations and structuring.
Work closely with Tax, Accounting, Treasury, FP&A, Corporate Development, and project teams to ensure financial conclusions reflect the appropriate treatment, assumptions, controls, and enterprise requirements.
Translate financial priorities into executable workplans with clear outputs, owners, milestones, dependencies, review points, and escalation paths; drive workstreams through completion.
Identify and improve financial processes, governance, model controls, reporting, and decision-support capabilities as Bell AI Fabric scales.

Critical Qualifications

Typically 6-10 years of experience in strategic finance, corporate development, investment banking, management consulting, FP&A, project finance, accounting, or another environment that develops comparable financial and execution capabilities.
Strong financial modelling capability, including experience building integrated models, business cases, forecasts, sensitivities, and scenario analyses that support significant decisions.
Demonstrated ability to review complex models and analyses with precision, identify errors or unsupported assumptions, and improve the quality and clarity of the underlying work.
Strong PowerPoint, executive communication, and financial storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clean, decision-oriented materials for senior executives and the Bell AI Fabric Board.
Sound financial and commercial judgment, with the confidence to question stakeholders, pressure-test assumptions, and recommend a practical path forward.
Working knowledge of tax, accounting, and financial reporting considerations, and the ability to partner effectively with subject-matter experts.
Experience managing or developing others, setting clear expectations, reviewing work closely, and maintaining accountability without creating unnecessary hierarchy.
High capacity and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly across multiple urgent priorities without compromising accuracy or quality.
Ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, learn unfamiliar topics quickly, and invest additional effort during critical periods to reach a well-supported answer.

Preferred Qualifications

CPA, CFA, or equivalent financial designations or advanced finance training; candidates with strong equivalent experience are also encouraged to apply.
Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, investments, partnerships, due diligence, valuation, integration planning, or other transaction-related work.
Experience in infrastructure, technology, telecommunications, energy, data centres, project finance, or another capital-intensive industry.
Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with disciplined model structure, documentation, version control, and quality assurance.
Strong curiosity and a demonstrated ability to become credible quickly on unfamiliar commercial, technical, tax, and accounting topics.
A practical, collaborative, and low-ego working style, including comfort receiving challenge, changing course when the facts require it, and sharing credit with the team.
High standards for pace, precision, ownership, accountability, and follow-through, combined with a genuine interest in difficult problems and continuous learning.

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.
